_note: The character's moods (mood_controller.gd), apart from the climax gauge: more moods (a wish to drink and the like) are more entries. Each 0..1: start (a new character), per_minute (builds up by itself while the app runs, in a play or not), away (while the app was closed: settles towards a value drawn in toward, all of the way after settle_minutes - PR #25; a mood without it builds per_minute x the closed minutes up to away_minutes_max), touch (per touch area), play_per_second (x the pace's factor). satisfied: what a block's mood {key: "satisfied"} adds - Muse decides by her character whether her climax satisfied her (2026-11-02, the user's decision); it is taken only within satisfy_window_seconds after a climax of hers. levels: [from, name] - the level is in the state for Muse and a change of level is the event mood_changed. trigger: at this value, when she is left alone idle_seconds (no play, no package, no creation, no input) and cooldown_seconds have passed since her last own play, the action: masturbation starts the first of plays that can start here at the spot nearest her, at pace, raised by her climax gauge per pace_by_gauge unless Muse set a pace in the last muse_hold_seconds; it ends after her climax. muse: the other values a block's mood may send (Muse's calls by her character), each {set or add, min: the least value it needs (else refused too_low), effect: leak = her stream (pee_stream.gd), seconds}. bladder (尿意, the user's wish 2026-11-02): builds up by itself; relieved = she went to the toilet, leaked = she wet herself (from the level トイレに行きたい). Provisional: replace freely.
